name: wicket
description: One password and a ban list for everything you self-host behind a Cloudflare Tunnel. No Access, no fail2ban, no server.

scripts.deploy: echo 'Do NOT run bare `cf deploy`: in cf 1.0.0-beta.5 it uploads a version with no secrets. Use `cf deploy --secrets-file secrets.json` (see README) or `npm run config:wrangler && npx wrangler deploy`.' >&2 && exit 1
